neighbours.label: a request for someone's personal details: the name/address field list ('include your name, address ...')
fire: To enter the contest, send your full name, address and age to the station.
Each letter to the editor must include the writer's name and city.
When ordering, please provide your name, shipping address and email.
Guests should give their name and room number at the front desk.
Fill in your name, phone number and date of birth below.
All submissions need the author's name, email and a short bio.
Before the interview, state your name and current address for the record.
On the card, write your name, your class and your teacher's name.
quiet: The famous name of the restaurant drew tourists from the city.
The writer's name appeared on the cover in large gold letters.
My grandmother's old address was a small house near the station.
Nobody at the party could remember the guest's name that evening.
The street address was painted on the mailbox years ago.
The author's name became well known after her second novel.
He changed his name and moved to a new address in Spain.
The teacher's name was carved into the wooden desk by a student.

notes: card: peaks on ' address', ' author', ',', newline after 'your name' in forms and submission rules; logit effect of the - pole promotes ' info', ' date', ' contact', ' identity'. Probe: 'Her name was Clara' low, form requests high. Quiet items mention names/addresses outside a request for details.
